plan.title: Reject past start time in single-stage RFQ schedule

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case configuration.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply an RFQ template so the pricing sheet and schedule controls can be used.
Add the CYLINDER product and set the requested quantity to 10.
Set the required delivery location on the first line item.
Add the vendor required by the setup before opening the schedule.

args.goal: In the Schedule Event drawer, choose Start later, set today's start time to one hour in the past, click Save Schedule, and stop after the application refuses to save the schedule.

steps.note: Perform the date and time interaction that the catalog cannot parameterize directly on the create-screen schedule drawer.
Assert that Procol refused the past start time with the expected error.
